title: Fast Build Config
description: This file contains author name, min_sdk, dependencies, assets, and various build configurations. It also includes support for Kotlin, Java 8 features, and optimization settings.

author.title: Developer Name
author.description: This extension developer name will be included with the components_build_info.json.

min_sdk.title: Android minimum SDK API Level
min_sdk.description: The minimum version number of the Android SDK the extension needs in order to function properly. This must be greater than or equal to `14`.

compile_sdk.title: Android Compile SDK API Level
compile_sdk.description: Define the compile Android SDK API level.

target_platform.title: Target Platform
target_platform.description: Specify the target builder (AppInventor | Kodular | Niotron | AndroidBuilder)

default_args.title: Default Arguments
default_args.description: Define default arguments using space-separated values. (premium)

resolver.title: Resolver Tool
resolver.description: Select resolver tool between `gradle/maven` to fetch transitive dependencies.

repositories.title: Remote Repositories
repositories.description: Default repositories are Maven Central, Google Maven & Maven Local. If the library you want to use is not available in these repositories, add here by specifying their URLs.

dependencies.title: Runtime Dependencies
dependencies.description: Runtime dependencies [Remote and Local]. NOTE: Run `fast sync` command before building the extension when you're using local .aar or any remote dependencies.

compile_time.title: Compile-time Dependencies
compile_time.description: Compile-time dependencies [Remote and Local]. NOTE: Run `fast sync` command before building the extension when you're using local .aar or any remote dependencies.

shared_deps.title: Shared Dependencies
shared_deps.description: Common libraries to include as-is without optimization at compile time. Packaged within the extension's AAR to avoid D8 duplicate class conflicts. (premium)

excludes.title: Exclusions Dependencies
excludes.description: Define dependencies to skip during resolve. [Remote only]. NOTE: Run `fast sync` command before building the extension.

assets.title: Extension Assets
assets.description: Should be present into assets directory.

apply_rules.title: Collect ProGuard Rules
apply_rules.description: Define AAR libraries to apply ProGuard rules from them. [Remote and Local] (premium)

aars.title: Attach AARs Libraries
aars.description: Define AAR libraries to attach with extension. [Remote and Local]. NOTE: Remote libraries should be resolved as runtime or compile-time dependencies. (premium)

override.title: Overridable Libraries
override.description: Define libraries to override them over provided libraries. [Remote and Local] (premium)

manifests.title: Manifest Merger
manifests.description: Define AAR libraries to merge manifest from them. [Remote and Local]. NOTE: Remote libraries should be resolved as runtime or compile-time dependencies. (premium)

xmls.title: Attach Custom XML
xmls.description: Attach custom XML to bundle it with APK. It should be present into assets directory within relative child directory. (premium)

jni_libs.title: JNI Native Libraries
jni_libs.description: Attach JNI native libraries to bundle them with APK. [Should be present in assets directory within relative child directory] (premium)

target_abis.title: Target JNI ABIs
target_abis.description: Target ABIs for compiling/attaching native libraries. (premium) Defaults to all ABIs if not specified, or accepts only for the listed ABIs. Supported ABIs: arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86, x86_64

kotlin.title: Kotlin Standard Libraries
kotlin.description: If enabled, Kotlin Standard Libraries will be included with the extension.

kotlin_version.title: Kotlin Compiler version
kotlin_version.description: Set the version of kotlin-compiler. NOTE: Run `fast sync` command before building the extension.

xtend.title: Xtend Standard Libraries
xtend.description: If enabled, Xtend Standard Libraries will be included with the extension. (premium)

fastguard.title: FastGuard Obfuscator
fastguard.description: Enable to obfuscate hardcoded string literals. NOTE: Accepts boolean, string (source) or array. (premium)

minimizer.title: Jar Minimizer
minimizer.description: If enabled, unused classes will be removed. [Accepts: boolean or array] (premium)

R8.title: R8 Shrinker
R8.description: If enabled, extension will be optimized using R8.

R8_fullMode.title: R8 Full Mode
R8_fullMode.description: Full mode does not automatically keep classes or members that are only referenced via reflection.

proguard.title: ProGuard Optimizer
proguard.description: If enabled, extension will be optimized using ProGuard.

desugar_sources.title: Desugaring Sources
desugar_sources.description: Enable to desugar extension's source code. (Requires premium if JDK 11 or above)

desugar_deps.title: Desugaring Dependencies
desugar_deps.description: Enable to desugar runtime dependencies. (Requires premium if JDK 11 or above)

desugar_dex.title: Desugaring DEX
desugar_dex.description: If enabled, the D8 tool will generate desugared classes.dex.

syntax.title: Modern Java Syntax
syntax.description: Enable to use modern Java (9-25) syntax. (premium)

gen_docs.title: Docs Generator
gen_docs.description: Enable to write docs in Markdown during build. It also generate blocks as PNG for App Inventor, Kodular, Niotron and AndroidBuilder. Pass `-b` as an additional argument to trigger the Docs Generator.

shadow_blocks.title: Shadow Generator
shadow_blocks.description: Enable to generate blocks with shadow blocks. NOTE: Blocks generator should be enabled. (premium)

auto_version.title: Auto-increment Version
auto_version.description: Enable to increment the version number of each component during build.

deannonate.title: De-annonate
deannonate.description: Enable to remove @annotations from the extension.

omit_provided_classes.title: Omit Platform Provided Classes
omit_provided_classes.description: Enable to remove platform provided classes from extension.

mock_js.title: Mock JS for each Component.
mock_js.description: The file name should be like `ComponentName.mock.js`. It should be present into assets directory. [Upcoming feature]

mock_css.title: Mock Css for each Component.
mock_css.description: The file name should be like `ComponentName.mock.css`. It should be present into assets directory. [Upcoming feature]
